_why: Every vendor of tooling/capability-register.json `vendors` and every provider of tooling/legal/provider-register.json `providers` that is NOT an adapter of some tooling/ports/<capability>.json. tooling/ci/assert-ports.mjs limb 8 requires each id to be exactly one adapter's `vendor` or exactly one row here, so a vendor nobody placed fails the build.
`until` names the train that will port it; `nonPort: true` marks one deliberately never ported (a platform authority, a store, a retired rail). A row carries exactly one of the two.

The nikatru.com zone (DNS records, WAF custom rules, Access apps, tunnel ingress) is DECLARED, NOT PORTED: tooling/edge/zone.json, read by tooling/ops/check-edge-zone.mjs, whose --export is the DNS-provider move's worklist.

rows.reason: Config transport (KV), D1, R2 and the Worker bindings sit behind ConfigTransport and the shared D1 helpers, not yet behind a storage or SQL port.
The captcha is the platform's abuse authority for sign-up; a gate, not a replaceable service.
The workflow-dispatch call from the Worker cron (dispatchGithubWorkflows); the code host is ported by port-codehost.
Sign in with Apple token revocation: Apple is the platform authority for its own identities.
Device attestation is answered only by the platform that made the device.
Device attestation is answered only by the platform that made the device.
A store is a distribution channel and the billing authority for its own buyers (tooling/channel-register.json), not a vendor to swap.

The support mailbox and the backup store (Drive, through an rclone crypt remote): operator tooling on the boxes and the owner's mailbox, not a service any Worker or app calls, so there is no seam in this repository to port.
A retired rail ([ADR 039] D4): no adapter exists and none will be built; kept in the provider register for disclosure history.
